text: 下周关注丨9月CPI等数据将公布，这些投资机会最靠谱 成品油将迎来调价窗口、下周将举办广交会等多个活动……
text_en: Next week's focus | September CPI and other data to be released, these investment opportunities are the most reliable; refined oil prices will usher in an adjustment window, the Canton Fair and other events will be held next week...
